title: IntBuffer Deep Copy
hints: Assignment is harder because `*this` already owns an array. Safe order: allocate the new array, copy into it, `delete[]` the old one, install the new pointer, update `n_`, `return *this;`. Never `delete[] data_` *before* you have finished reading from `o`: when `&o == this` you would be reading freed memory. An `if (this == &o) return *this;` guard at the top handles that case explicitly.
